equity.level_reason: Subgroups (persons in prisons, transgender persons, males, children) are reported with changes and framed as a health-equity concern, but contrasts are set side by side and no between-group difference is computed, which caps the level at 2. The within-group percent changes do not count as a quantified disparity.

notes: Subgroup values are reported from Table 1 with within-group percent changes; no between-group contrast, CI or test is given, so procedures is empty. Table 2 sex comparisons within age groups are descriptive, with no adjustment.
view_issues: Text says pregnant women's suppression increased in 2017–2022, but Table 1 shows 95% to 92% (change −3). The Table 2 footnote defines suppression among those tested, while the article's § § § note says among all persons identified with HIV.
